title: salvia apiana
intro: Salvia apiana, commonly known as White Sage, is a perennial shrubby plant native to the southwestern United States and northwestern Mexico, belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). The plant has been used for centuries in traditional medicine to provide relief from various health issues, including respiratory problems, skin irritations, and anxiety. The health benefits of Salvia apiana are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, as well as its ability to stimulate digestion and relieve stress. The bioactive constituents of White Sage include triterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
